sentences.en: Don't slacken your pace now! You're almost at the finish line!
sentences.zh: 现在别放松速度！你快到终点线了!

sentences.en: The crossing cables have slackened dramatically.
sentences.zh: 过河的缆绳松弛了很多。

sentences.en: The wind began to slacken as the day turned into evening.
sentences.zh: 随着白天变成傍晚，风开始减弱了。

senses.zh: 松劲，懈怠；变松弛；变缓慢
